summary: Adds a controlled path for selected iMessage chats to reach the desktop agent, with a Settings permission switch for group access.

sections.title: What this ship changes for you
items: Adds a controlled path for selected iMessage chats to reach the desktop agent, with a Settings permission switch for group access.
Checks group membership before granting full access and returns to limited access when the roster changes or cannot be verified.
